description: Recolour an existing pixel art image so every pixel uses a colour from the given palette (e.g. PICO-8 or Game Boy). Size is kept.

input.description: Path or URL of a PNG or JPEG image

palette.description: Palette name (pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, game-boy, 1-bit) or hex colours like "#1a1c2c,#5d275d"

name: remap_palette
title: Recolour to a palette
